# FilmMakerStudio

> Write, plan and shoot your film. A browser-based studio for independent filmmakers: write the screenplay, plan the shoot, run the set. Work is saved in the browser, with optional sign-in sync and Google Drive backup. Plans are bought one year at a time; each plan's price and terms are on the pricing page.

This file is GENERATED by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs from the public pages' own titles and descriptions.

## Site

- [FilmMakerStudio: from first draft to final call sheet](https://filmmakerstudio.in/start): Write the screenplay, break it down and plan the shoot in one place. Built for indie directors, writers and line producers; your work stays in your own browser.
- [Pricing](https://filmmakerstudio.in/pricing): Three plans, each a year of the studio. Compare what Basic, Intermediate and Pro include, feature by feature, with each plan's price and terms.
- [Contact us · FilmMakerStudio](https://filmmakerstudio.in/contact): Questions, bug reports, billing and refunds, feature requests and press: write to the FilmMakerStudio team.
- [About us · FilmMakerStudio](https://filmmakerstudio.in/about): A local-first studio for Tamil and Indian filmmakers, from idea to call sheet: write the story and the screenplay, plan the shoot, all saved in your own browser first.
- [Your work stays yours: storage, exports and who can see a script](https://filmmakerstudio.in/trust): Where FilmMakerStudio keeps your screenplay, which open formats it exports, how Drive backup and offline work, who can read a project, and what you keep if the service ever stops.

## Product

- [Screenplay writer for Tamil, Tanglish and English](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-writing): Write a formatted screenplay in Tamil, Tanglish or English. Slug lines, action and dialogue format as you type, with numbered drafts, and export to PDF, Word, Final Draft and Fountain.
- [Beat sheet and story structure tool for filmmakers](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-story): Build your story on a beat board, pick from 11 structures, and see where the pacing rises and sags before you write a page of screenplay.
- [Storyboard and shot visualiser for indie directors](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-storyboard): Give every planned shot a frame. Link a picture or describe it, plan camera and actor blocking, and keep the storyboard in step with your shot list.
- [Script breakdown software with auto-tagging](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-breakdown): Break a screenplay down scene by scene. Auto-tag suggests cast, props, vehicles, stunts and sounds. You accept what is right and the schedule follows.
- [Film element catalog: every prop, costume and vehicle](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-catalog): See everything your film needs, listed once, with the scenes that need it. Props, wardrobe, vehicles and more, built from your breakdown.
- [Shot list maker with PDF and CSV export](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-shot-list): Plan the shots in every scene with size, angle, movement and lens, then print a shot division or export it as a spreadsheet.
- [Stripboard and day out of days scheduling](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-schedule): Lay scenes into shoot days on a stripboard, see which actor works which day, and print the schedule.
- [Film budget in rupees with Chennai rates](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-budget): Estimate what the film costs line by line from Chennai rates, track what is spent against the plan, and lock budget versions you can compare.
- [Call sheet maker with WhatsApp sharing](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-call-sheets): Build one call sheet per shoot day from your scenes and unit list. Print it, or send it as a WhatsApp message with each person's own call time.
- [Cast and crew directory for your film unit](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-cast-crew): Keep cast and crew in one directory by department, with phone and email. Call sheets are built from the same list, so a change is made once.
- [Script sides for the day, ready to print](https://filmmakerstudio.in/product-sides): Tick the scenes being shot and print sides with slug, length, synopsis and elements, one block per scene, ready for the actors.

## Guides

- [How to make a film call sheet (with a WhatsApp version)](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-call-sheet): A step-by-step guide to the film call sheet: what it must say, when to send it, and how to turn it into a WhatsApp message each person can read at five in the morning.
- [Tamil screenplay format: headings, dialogue and page count](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-tamil-screenplay-format): How to lay out a Tamil screenplay: English scene headings and action, dialogue in Tamil script or Tanglish, character cues, parentheticals, and why the page count stays honest only on a fixed-width grid.
- [How to budget a short film in rupees](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-short-film-budget): How to build a short-film budget in India line by line: the categories, why the shoot days drive most of the cost, crew bata, contingency, and tracking petty cash against the plan once the shoot starts.
- [How to do a script breakdown, scene by scene](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-script-breakdown): A walkthrough of the script breakdown: numbering scenes, marking cast, props, wardrobe, vehicles and effects in a colour code, the breakdown sheet, and how the breakdown feeds the schedule and budget.
- [CBFC certification checklist for independent films](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-cbfc-checklist): A checklist for CBFC film certification in India: the U, UA 7+, UA 13+, UA 16+ and A categories, the tobacco and drug warnings, AWBI permission for animals, child artists, and what to prepare before applying. Sources and dates on the page.
- [OTT delivery specs checklist: masters, sound, subtitles, paperwork](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-ott-delivery): A checklist of what a streaming platform asks a film to deliver: picture masters, textless versions, sound mixes and stems, timed text, the CBFC certificate and chain of title. With what Netflix and Prime Video publish, and what to ask platforms that do not.
- [Film festival planner: premieres, deadlines and formats](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guide-festival-planner): How to plan a short film's festival run: why the premiere decides the order, choosing tiers, building a calendar back from deadlines, entry fees, and the screener and DCP files festivals ask for.
- [Filmmaking guides: call sheets, breakdowns, budgets, CBFC and delivery](https://filmmakerstudio.in/guides): Practical, plain-English guides for independent filmmakers in India: the call sheet, Tamil screenplay format, a short-film budget, the script breakdown, CBFC certification, OTT delivery and festival planning.
